summary: Russell carries momentum into the Dutch Grand Prix after dominating the sprint from pole, but Norris and Leclerc loom as threats to Mercedes' momentum at Zandvoort's high-speed layout. Red Bull's championship challenge faces a fresh blow with Hadjar sidelined by a wrist injury, forcing the team to shuffle its setup strategy during what could prove a critical weekend. Victory here becomes essential for title contenders seeking to build advantage before the season's final stretch, with Zandvoort hosting its last-ever Formula 1 race.
